headlines.headline: St. John's forward Babacar Sane granted temporary eligibility via court order
headlines.detail: A New York Supreme Court TRO lets Sane practice with the Red Storm after the NCAA denied reinstatement over his G-League past; an Oct. 1 hearing decides if he can play in 2026-27.

headlines.headline: Suns center Mark Williams out extended time after shoulder surgery
headlines.detail: Williams had surgery Thursday for a torn labrum suffered in an offseason workout; DeMar DeRozan (Nuggets) and Ben Simmons (Clippers) signed one-year deals this week.

headlines.headline: Seahawks beat Patriots 13-10 in Super Bowl LX rematch, but lose Darnold to hip injury
headlines.detail: Drew Lock led Seattle to a 1-0 start after Sam Darnold exited early; Darnold expected to miss Week 2. Patriots' Drake Maye threw three picks in the loss.

headlines.headline: Baylor's DJ Lagway ruled out for Week 2 with ankle sprain
headlines.detail: Lagway will sit Saturday vs. Prairie View A&M after spraining his ankle in a 17-16 loss to Auburn; Nate Bennett starts in his place.
